name: What is AEO for contractors and why is it important?

mainEntity.name: What is AEO for contractors and why is it important?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO, or Authoritative Entity Optimization, for contractors focuses on establishing a contractor's brand and services as highly trustworthy and relevant within their industry and local market. It involves optimizing online presence to signal authority to search engines through consistent business information, high-quality content, positive reviews, and strong local citations. This process helps contractors rank higher in search results, attract more qualified leads, and build a reputation as a reliable and expert service provider, ultimately leading to increased business visibility and growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO for contractors establishes brand authority online, helping them rank higher in search results and attract more leads by signaling trustworthiness to search engines.
